name: one
description: Use ONE operational workspaces and publish branded client decks from Codex Desktop with per-user OAuth and live permissions.

interface.shortDescription: Work with your ONE operations data.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex Desktop directly to ONE using your own ONE account. ONE re-evaluates live role, board, project, sharing, and module permissions for every tool call across operational records, project planning, Procurement, Remote Machines, Hardware, private documents, Finance, protected backups, organization-published brand standards, and branded HTML/PDF client deck publishing. Hiring remains ONE UI-only.
defaultPrompt: List the ONE boards I can access.
Get my organization's ONE-published brand standards before designing a presentation.
Create and publish a branded client deck with an optional passcode and matching PDF.
Find recent contacts in ONE matching a company name.
Create an item in ONE after confirming the board and fields.
List Hardware assets and their private documents that I can access.
List recent ONE backup metadata without exporting protected data.
Audit ONE access and API-key metadata without exposing secrets.
Create a Procurement request after showing its ordered approval chain.
Show a project's statuses and sprints before changing its planning structure.
